speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: The band is clean. I am not asking where a clean band goes on a Tuesday.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Westminster, Mistress. By water. I am not bringing you a name to carry into the close.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Shall I pin it, or will it sit if I only set it on the chair?

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: You will pin it, and you will not pin a question under it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Pin it, Alse. I am at the stairs by five. The house can have the evening without a report.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Then the house will have it. Once was enough of a play. Another man's parlour is not my second time.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: It is work. I will be late. I will not wake the stair to say so.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: The pin is in. I am not asking about boys.
